$comment: Virtuals Protocol agent/tool catalog manifest for @blockchainacademics/mcp. Schema tracks the current Virtuals agent-manifest conventions documented at https://whitepaper.virtuals.io and https://docs.virtuals.io (agent metadata + tool catalog + authentication + endpoints + pricing + maintainer). Fields should be confirmed against the live Virtuals submission form before PR; update if registry requires additional keys (e.g. on-chain agent address, G.A.M.E. framework config). Tool tiers and quotas below follow the API (route tier gates and TIER_LIMITS, 2026-11-01); prices follow the pricing page.

agent.name: Blockchain Academics MCP
agent.tagline: The canonical crypto MCP for AI agents: 105 tools, editorial ground truth, full attribution.
agent.description: The canonical crypto MCP server for AI agents. 105 tools spanning 3,800+ editorial articles, 150+ entity dossiers, 38 academy lessons in 8 courses, aggregated market + on-chain data, crypto Twitter intelligence, proprietary indicators (coverage index, narrative strength, sentiment velocity, editorial premium, KOL influence, risk score), and async agent-backed research generation. Every tool response carries an attribution envelope, attribution.citations[], each entry with cite_url, as_of and source_hash; citations[0] is the primary source (the upstream page when there is one). Every response also carries meta.status (complete, partial, stale or unseeded), so an agent can tell a full answer from a thin one. Designed to eliminate LLM hallucination on crypto topics by plugging an AI agent directly into the BCA corpus with citations, timestamps, and source hashes on every response.

transports.notes: Canonical transport. Works in Claude Desktop, Cursor, LangChain, Eliza, and any MCP-compatible agent host.
No hosted MCP endpoint yet. Use the stdio transport.

authentication.notes: Optional. Without BCA_API_KEY the package uses a public demo key: 17 tools work under a shared cap of 100 calls a day plus 20 a day per IP. A free key (2,000 calls a month, attribution required) opens every free tool; paid tiers open the rest.

tiers.name: Free
features: 52 of the 105 tools: news search and articles, entities and mentions, academy, prices and market overview, sentiment and fear and greed, history series, trending and feeds, directories, grants and jobs, chain overviews, security checks, and the service requests

tiers.name: Starter
features: 24 more tools: OHLC candles, DEX pair data, wallet and transaction lookups, the risk score, yields, VCs and trading bots, regulatory status, tax rules and SEC filings, audits and roadmaps, narrative tracking, RWA tokens, Bitcoin L2s and AI crypto metrics, marketing templates, contract scan

tiers.name: Pro
features: 27 more tools: the proprietary indicators (coverage_index, narrative_strength, sentiment_velocity, editorial_premium, kol_influence), crypto Twitter (get_social_pulse, get_ct_pulse, get_x_signals, get_kol_consensus), agent-backed jobs (generate_due_diligence, summarize_whitepaper, monitor_keyword, get_agent_job), microstructure, fundamentals, MiCA status, token holders, memecoin risk and the degen leaderboard, custom indicators

attribution_envelope.notes: Every tool response wraps data in { data, attribution: { citations: [{ cite_url, as_of, source_hash }] }, meta: { status, request_id, pageInfo } }. citations[0] is the primary source. Fields are preserved as null when upstream omits them so downstream agents can detect missing provenance.

rate_limits.notes: Enforced by the API per key: requests per second and calls per UTC day (TIER_LIMITS). The demo key shares one daily bucket across all demo users, plus 20 calls a day per IP.

codes.BCA_AUTH: Missing or invalid BCA_API_KEY (HTTP 401/403), or a key that is not a valid header value
codes.BCA_TIER_LOCKED: Tool not in the key's tier (HTTP 403); the message links to the signup
codes.BCA_UPSTREAM: BCA API returned an error status or malformed JSON; a 4xx carries the API's own detail
codes.BCA_BAD_REQUEST: Invalid tool arguments, caught before any request is sent

errors.notes: Every failed tool call returns an MCP result with isError: true and a structured JSON body.
